changelog: Sales lead page: the follow-up and the interactions sit side by side at the top (the separate "last interaction" box is gone); the follow-up offers quick dates and "Complete follow-up", which opens the interaction form pre-filled; the contact's phone and e-mail are `tel:`/`mailto:` links that also open an interaction draft; `N` opens the interaction form (#3737–#3742).

en: Lead page: follow-up and interactions now sit side by side at the top. Pick a follow-up date in one click, complete a follow-up straight into the interaction log, call or e-mail the contact with one click, and press N to log an interaction.
tr: Lead sayfası: takip ve etkileşimler artık en üstte yan yana. Takip tarihini tek tıkla seç, takibi tamamlayıp doğrudan etkileşim olarak kaydet, kişiyi tek tıkla ara ya da e-posta yaz, etkileşim eklemek için N'ye bas.
de: Lead-Seite: Wiedervorlage und Interaktionen stehen jetzt oben nebeneinander. Termin mit einem Klick wählen, eine Wiedervorlage direkt als Interaktion erfassen, den Kontakt mit einem Klick anrufen oder anschreiben, und mit N eine Interaktion erfassen.
